newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filinvest tumbles 7.94 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Filinvest tumbles 7.94 pct in early trade.

text.p: Filinvest Land Inc shed 50 centavos, or 7.94 percent, to 5.80 pesos in early trade on Tuesday as market reacted to news of its failure to receive an environmental clearance certificate (ECC) for a major project, brokers said.
"The main issue is that Filinvest was not granted a clearance for a big project," said Carl Valentin, analyst at Asia Pacific Capital Equities.
"It is an immediate reaction to the ECC issue," said Helen Alvarez, research director at All Asia Securities.

The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) refused to give Filinvest clearance for its Sky City commercial and golf course project, east of Manila. FLI said it was also fined 50,000 pesos for alleged violation of the environmental impact assessment law.
FLI has questioned the basis for the denial, appealing to the Office of the President to reconsider.
Anscor-Hagedorn Securities vice-president Noel Reyes said the impact on Filinvest's earnings will likely be felt in 1998.
Alvarez added that the market is merely overreacting as any delays on the Sky City project will only have a slight impact, about four percent, on Filinvest earnings.
FLI was among the most heavily traded issues.
